//: Rules for scripts/governance/ratchet-baseline.mjs. Delete the example rules your stack does not use. Rules match one line at a time unless "multiline": true. A rule that scans zero files is an error (exit 2); the cross-language examples carry "allowEmpty": true, so remove it from every rule that covers your main source tree. mustMatch and mustNotMatch are self-tests checked on every run. Adopt a rule with --init (first baseline) or --init-rule <id> (rule added later); afterwards new findings fail and the baseline only shrinks via --prune. Never delete a recorded rule: mark it { "id": ..., "retired": "<reason>" }. For linter output (ruff, eslint, clippy, golangci-lint), declare { "id": ..., "external": true } and pass --findings <json>.

mustNotMatch: const x = y as unknown as Config
rules.message: Use a typed value, or validate untrusted data at the boundary, instead of `as any`.
Handle, log, or rethrow the error; an empty catch hides failures.
Handle or re-raise; a handler whose body is only `pass` silently swallows the error.
Catch a named exception type; a bare except also swallows KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit.
Propagate the error with `?` or handle it; `unwrap()` turns a recoverable failure into a panic.
